Method of Attack: Buffer overflow exploiting integer underflow in packet descriptors of Intel PRO/1000 MT Desktop (82540EM) network adapter in NAT mode
Escape from guest virtual environment to host Ring 3 privilege layer
Privilege escalation via chaining another vulnerability to gain Ring 0 access through /dev/vboxdrv
Impacted Systems: VirtualBox virtualization software on all supported operating systems
Attack Vector: Exploitation of vulnerability in Intel PRO/1000 MT Desktop (82540EM) network adapter configured in NAT mode within VirtualBox guest VM
